The report does not provide a single explicit quantified prior year reserve movement for 2021; the Managing Agent describes an improvement in closed years (2019 and prior) but 2021 was dominated by natural catastrophe activity (Hurricane Ida, European floods and Winterstorm Uri) which increased current year catastrophe losses. As a result the overall picture is mixed: prior year closed-year results showed improvement according to management commentary, while current-year catastrophe activity exerted upward pressure on claims. gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: The report does not present a single explicit aggregate 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure for 2021. A claims development triangle is present but the underwriting/close activity (reinsurance to close, quota-share/funds withheld arrangements and RITC for closed years) and RITC transactions distort direct extraction of a reliable prior-year development aggregate. Accordingly prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. Opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2020) is clearly stated as GBP 361.9m (page 83). Gross premium total is taken from the Chairman's summary (GBP 380m) as the detailed 2021 segmental premium breakdown by statutory class is not available in the parsed notes; gross_premium_mix is therefore omitted. Where inferences were made (LOB movements, causes), confidence levels are indicated above.
